Boolean flag in FactRegistry marking whether at least one fact was registered.
StarkVerifier security parameter; number of security bits required by the proof.

Array of 20 PeriodicColumnContract references used to compute periodic column values.

Checks the out-of-domain-sampling values by static-calling the constraint polynomial contract.
MerkleVerifier.verify: verifies a Merkle decommitment of n leaves and compares to root.
VerifierChannel.sendFieldElements: derives pseudo-random field elements into target memory.
VerifierChannel.sendRandomQueries: derives, sorts and deduplicates query indices.
VerifierChannel.verifyProofOfWork: checks the PoW nonce against a threshold derived from proofOfWorkBits.
Reads and validates the last FRI layer coefficients directly from the proof memory.

Precomputes the FRI coset group and half inverse group inside the FRI context.
Horner polynomial evaluation over a coefficient buffer.
Computes the batch-inverse of all OODS denominators and FRI inverse points.
MimcConstraintPoly fallback: copies calldata to memory and evaluates the composition polynomial.
MimcOods fallback: copies calldata and sums the OODS boundary constraints for all queries.
MemoryAccessUtils.getPtr: bounds-checked offset-to-pointer conversion into ctx.
Modular exponentiation wrapper around the modexp precompile (0x05).
Verifies the last FRI layer by Horner evaluation at inverted query points.
FriLayer.computeNextLayer: folds all live queries into the next FRI layer.
Gathers the coset elements for the query at the head of the FRI queue.
Reads query responses from the proof, hashes rows into leaves and verifies the Merkle path.
Offsets query indices by eval domain size and computes the corresponding evaluation points.
MimcVerifier constructor wiring constraintPoly, constantsCols and oodsContractAddress.
msg.sender of the publicly reachable verifyProofAndRegister entry point.
STATICCALL into constraintPoly with ctx-derived calldata and revert-on-failure handling.
STATICCALL into oodsContractAddress receiving the whole ctx and returning data into the FRI queue.
Storage write verifiedFact[factHash] = true performed after external calls.
Unchecked mulmod/addmod field arithmetic used throughout the verifier; relies on modular reduction for safety.

edges.reason: verifyProofAndRegister calls verifyProof to validate the STARK proof.
verifyProofAndRegister calls registerFact after verification succeeds.
The storage write of the fact happens only after verifyProof performed external calls to the constraint polynomial and OODS contracts; ordering must remain correct.
verifyProof initialises verifier parameters through initVerifierParams.
verifyProof invokes oodsConsistencyCheck.
verifyProof derives coefficients/OODS values via sendFieldElements.
verifyProof generates the random query indices via sendRandomQueries.
verifyProof performs the proof of work check.
verifyProof reads the last FRI layer commitment.
verifyProof builds the first FRI layer.
initVerifierParams calls airSpecificInit to build the contract-specific context.
initVerifierParams validates FRI parameters through validateFriParams.
readLastFriLayer reads raw bytes from the channel via readQueryResponsesAndDecommit-style data handling.
computeFirstFriLayer path adjusts query indices and prepares evaluation points.
FRI layer verification calls the Merkle verifier.
friVerifyLayers initialises and folds the FRI layers.
friVerifyLayers finishes by verifying the last FRI layer.
friVerifyLayers computes each next layer with computeNextLayer.
readQueryResponsesAndDecommit calls the Merkle verifier on the collected leaves.
computeNextLayer gathers coset inputs for each live query.
verifyLastLayer evaluates the polynomial with hornerEval.
computeFirstFriLayer static-calls the OODS contract with the full context before any state is written.
oodsConsistencyCheck static-calls the constraint polynomial contract with ctx-derived calldata.
proofParams calldata is consumed by verifyProofAndRegister.
proof calldata is consumed by verifyProofAndRegister.
publicInput calldata is consumed by verifyProofAndRegister.
msg.sender may be any address, so the external proof submission path is permissionless and must be validated.
publicInput is read by airSpecificInit to fill the context.
factHash flows into registerFact and is written to verifiedFact.
fact is used as the lookup key in isValid.
channelPtr locates the proof pointer used by the Merkle verifier.
queuePtr locates the leaf queue consumed by the Merkle verifier.
root is compared against the computed Merkle hash.
n bounds the number of leaves read by the Merkle verifier.
nElements drives the loop writing pseudo-random field elements.
proofOfWorkBits determines the left-shift used to build the PoW threshold.
coefsStart is the base pointer of the coefficient buffer.
point is the evaluation point multiplied into the Horner accumulator.
nCoefs bounds the Horner loop and is checked by require statements.
ctx carries the verifier context into the FRI layer verification.
nPoints bounds the last-layer verification loop.
count bounds the number of random queries generated.
mask is applied to the raw random value to obtain the query index.
registerFact performs the storage write of the verified fact.
registerFact flips the anyFactRegistered flag on first registration.
isValid reads the verifiedFact mapping.
The constructor assigns the constraint polynomial contract address, which is later static-called.
The constructor assigns the OODS contract address, which is later static-called.
The constructor populates the periodic column contract array used during the OODS check.
oodsConsistencyCheck reads constraintPoly to perform the static-call.
oodsConsistencyCheck calls constantsCols[i].compute for the 20 periodic columns.
The overflow guard protects the unchecked loop that multiplies nElements by 0x20.
verifyProofOfWork performs the shift that can misbehave when proofOfWorkBits is out of range.
The MimcConstraintPoly fallback copies attacker-controlled calldata into memory.
expmod assembly uses unchecked mulmod/addmod field arithmetic.
hornerEval performs unchecked mulmod/add chains before the final modulo.
The local accumulator res of expmod holds the modexp precompile result.
ctxSize controls how many calldata bytes the MimcOods fallback copies into memory.
batchInverseArray is filled by oodsPrepareInverses with partial products and denominators.
nFriSteps is derived from proofParams inside initVerifierParams.
friStep tracks the FRI layer index in friVerifyLayers.
nLiveQueries tracks the surviving queries across FRI layers.
compositionFromTraceValue receives the static-call result in oodsConsistencyCheck.
claimedComposition is compared with compositionFromTraceValue.
proofOfWorkThreshold is compared against the PoW digest.
queryIdx is inserted into the sorted queries array by sendRandomQueries.
groupOrderMinusOne is the exponent used to invert the FRI query point.
The static-call from oodsConsistencyCheck re-enters the MimcConstraintPoly fallback, which is read-only.
The static-call to oodsContractAddress re-enters the MimcOods fallback before registerFact writes the fact to storage.

normalization_plan.reason: proofParams is only meaningful as the calldata argument forwarded to the proof verification entry point.
proof is the serialized proof buffer consumed by the entry point.
publicInput is the caller-supplied public input array of the entry point.
factHash is the single argument written into storage by registerFact.
fact is the sole lookup key of isValid.
channelPtr only serves to locate the proof pointer inside the Merkle verification loop.
queuePtr defines the leaf queue memory region of the Merkle verifier.
root is only used in the final equality require of the Merkle verifier.
n parametrises the Merkle verification loop and its bound check.
nElements bounds the assembly loop that writes random field elements.
proofOfWorkBits is the only difficulty parameter of the PoW check.
coefsStart is the base pointer of the polynomial buffer in hornerEval.
point is the evaluation point folded into the Horner accumulator.
nCoefs bounds and validates the Horner evaluation loop.
ctx is the verifier context threaded through every FRI routine.
nPoints bounds the last-layer verification loop.
count bounds the random query generation loop.
mask is applied to the random value to derive each query index.
res is the local accumulator returned by expmod from the modexp precompile.
ctxSize is computed locally in the MimcOods fallback to size the calldatacopy.
batchInverseArray is the scratch buffer filled by oodsPrepareInverses.
nFriSteps is derived locally from proofParams inside initVerifierParams.
friStep is the local layer counter of friVerifyLayers.
nLiveQueries is the local count of queries surviving each FRI layer.
compositionFromTraceValue is the local holder of the constraint polynomial static-call result.
claimedComposition is the prover-supplied value compared inside the OODS consistency check.
proofOfWorkThreshold is the local difficulty threshold derived inside the PoW check.
queryIdx is the masked index inserted into the sorted query array.
groupOrderMinusOne is the local inversion exponent used in verifyLastLayer.
